Spokane is a short stub going north off the top plate edge (paper x ~7882-7975). Hewitt = the 'AVE.' along the top of the plate (south block line ~265); its north side is cut by the plate edge, so y is estimated. A second 'AVE.' runs parallel at y~780 but Spokane does not reach it.
Annwood is a stub going north off the plate edge (x ~9502-9578). Madison Road (80 ft) south edge ~3952 at that x; north side is the plate edge, so y is estimated.

At the expected point there is only the straight N-S street printed 'ALMS' (centre x ~2585). Nothing branches from it or crosses it near y 5581, only a green boundary band at y~5600. Victory Parkway does not exist separately here in 1922.
